registration.statement: Every positive principal shell n contains all orbit ranks One through n, so the admitted capacities sum exactly to 2n squared.  Increasing joint cover with retained principal-rank tie order generates the complete filling recurrence.  The first filled cell and each later filled rank-two outer boundary force closure coordinates 2, 10, 18, 36, 54, 86 and 118 and period widths 2, 8, 8, 18, 18, 32 and 32. The physical ionization signature is a rising period envelope followed by a closure-to-successor reset, not a false claim of strict monotonicity inside every period.
